explication: Munder Difflin is an Electron desktop harness that turns terminal coding CLIs into a coordinated team of agents, represented on a shared office floor. The principal workflow is to configure an agent, launch its real CLI in a pseudo-terminal, and coordinate work through Michael and the hive while agents retain memory. The README also describes voice/realtime controls, integrations and webhooks, and workspace tools. The tree and excerpts establish the UI, IPC, runtime, and feature modules; some internal wiring is inferred only where the README explicitly documents the behavior.
